name: glass-notification-aurora
title: Glass Notification Aurora
description: Two frosted-glass notification cards slide over a slowly moving aurora backdrop: one fills a progress bar and flips to done, the other types a reply.
useWhen: Notification cards should feel premium and float over a colourful animated backdrop.
A product or app moment (export done, new message) needs a glassy UI overlay.
avoidWhen: The cards must refract the scene behind them like real glass: this block blurs and tints but does not bend it.
A flat, simple notification: use a plain notification block.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
